theory.intro: **Congruent** figures have exactly the same shape and the same size. If a translation (slide), a reflection (flip) or a rotation (turn) moves one figure exactly on top of another, the two are congruent.
facts: In congruent figures, corresponding (matching) sides are equal and corresponding angles are equal.
Sides with the same number of tick marks are equal, and angles with the same mark are equal.
Two circles are congruent exactly when their radii are equal.
steps: If a translation, reflection or rotation is supplied, use it to explain why the figures are congruent. If congruence is given, use the figures and matching marks to identify corresponding features.
Match each vertex of the original with its image, using the transformation or the matching marks.
Read off the corresponding sides and angles from the matched vertices.

foundation.question_text:
$\triangle KLM$ has been translated to give $\triangle RST$. The translation moves $K$ to $R$, $L$ to $S$ and $M$ to $T$.
Name the side in $\triangle RST$ that corresponds to $KM$.
foundation.solution_text:
$K$ corresponds to $R$ and $M$ corresponds to $T$.
Side $KM$ corresponds to side $RT$.

$B$ is the vertex where the double-tick side meets the single-tick side.
In $\triangle LMN$ the double-tick side $MN$ meets the single-tick side $NL$ at $N$.
$B$ corresponds to $N$.

The reflection matches $A \leftrightarrow F$, $B \leftrightarrow E$, $C \leftrightarrow H$ and $D \leftrightarrow G$.
Side $AD$ corresponds to side $FG$.

$\angle B$ carries the double arc.
In $\triangle XYZ$ the double arc is at $Y$.
$\angle B$ corresponds to $\angle Y$.

development.solution_text:
Matching the figures gives $K \leftrightarrow P$, $L \leftrightarrow Q$, $M \leftrightarrow R$ and $N \leftrightarrow S$.
$L$ corresponds to $Q$.

Following each vertex through the quarter turn: the longest side $AB$ maps onto $PQ$ and the shortest side $BC$ maps onto $QR$.
$A \leftrightarrow P$, $B \leftrightarrow Q$ and $C \leftrightarrow R$.

Side $TU$ carries the double tick.
In $\triangle XYZ$ the double tick is on side $YZ$.
$TU$ corresponds to $YZ$.

$\angle D$ carries the double arc.
In $EFGH$ the double arc is at $H$.
$\angle D$ corresponds to $\angle H$.

The reflection matches $J \leftrightarrow U$, $K \leftrightarrow V$ and $L \leftrightarrow W$.
$\angle K$ corresponds to $\angle V$.

mastery.solution_text:
Matching the pentagons gives $K \leftrightarrow U$, $L \leftrightarrow V$, $M \leftrightarrow W$, $N \leftrightarrow X$ and $P \leftrightarrow Y$.
Side $LM$ corresponds to side $VW$.

$A$ is the vertex where the single-tick side meets the unmarked side.
In $WXYZ$ the single-tick side $WX$ meets the unmarked side $ZW$ at $W$.
$A$ corresponds to $W$.

The reflection matches $K \leftrightarrow R$, $L \leftrightarrow S$ and $M \leftrightarrow T$.
Side $LM$ corresponds to side $ST$.
